text:
deploy-bot: starting config-only rollout — routing prefs + batching cap. Canary 6% for 22m. Change window 18:45-20:45 UTC. Patch: bias eu-central +18%, reduce batch_max_tokens=18, per_router_concurrency=5, request_timeout_ms=1550. Health posts every 4m.

ivy: short rationale — EU p99 tails up; aim to shift a bit of steady traffic to eu-central and tighten batches. No model pins.

omar: exclude stress-test-tenant and corp-eta from canary; also enable OOM drain and mark unhealthy for 9m.

sre-bot: exclusions set [stress-test-tenant, corp-eta]; oom_drain=true; unhealthy_ttl_min=9.

kevin: rollback rules: abort if eu p99 > 1150ms or total_error_rate increases by >1.0% absolute or infra OOMs >=2 in 15m. Watch kv_cache_miss and per-router queue length.

ivy: ops snippet for runbook:
```yaml
change: config-only
canary:
  initial_pct: 6
  duration_min: 22
  step_up: [18,30]
routing_weights:
  eu-central-1: +18
  us-west-2: -8
batching:
  max_tokens: 18
  per_router_concurrency: 5
timeouts_ms: 1550
exclude: [stress-test-tenant, corp-eta]
autoscaler:
  oom_drain: true
  unhealthy_ttl_min: 9
rollback_triggers:
  eu_region_p99_ms: 1150
  error_rate_abs_pct: 1.0
  infra_ooms_15m: 2
```

deploy-bot: canary started 2026-08-14T18:46:50Z. Dash links: /dash/route-shift, /dash/batch-health. Paging to @ivy and @kevin on alerts.

(4m) sre-bot: health: eu p50 72ms p95 340ms p99 920ms; us p95 430ms; error_rate delta +0.2%; kv_cache_miss +0.5% — within guardrails.

(14m) omar: autoscaler drained a host after OOM, replacement up; traffic shifted with no client errors.

(23m) kevin: green to step to 18%. Proceeding to step-up after next 18m hold.

ivy: draft release note: "Config-only: weighted routing toward eu-central (+18), reduced batch_max_tokens to 18, per-router concurrency limited to 5, request timeout 1550ms. Canary 6% -> 18% -> 30% on green checks. Exclusions: stress-test-tenant, corp-eta. Rollback triggers: eu p99>1150ms, error rate +1.0% abs, or >=2 infra OOMs in 15m. Autoscaler oom drain enabled."

deploy-bot: available commands `/deploybot abort-config` to revert, `/deploybot show-exclusions`. Next automated health post in 4m with worst-sample logs and latency histograms.
